scope: All39 ordinary UXLC2.5 book files versus current vendored OSHB/WLC, with written-consonant differences joined to current POB source/English. Edition screening, not fresh manuscript collation or superiority evaluation.

uxlc.rights: Biblical Hebrew text may be copied without restriction with attribution appreciated; nontext files/site are separately copyrighted. Archive remains private, no full headers/images/site files vendored. Do not label UXLC as WLC.

acquisition.members_read: 39 ordinary Books/*.xml, excluding .DH.xml and Header/Index; metadata list retained for all members
acquisition.development_exposure: Publisher schema/format and local OSHB structural examples inspected before comparison. Not a blind reading benchmark. Initial direct lookup omitted Books/ prefix and failed; listed archive members then supplied exact names. No reacquisition or payload mutation.

comparison.alignment: Exact mapped book and chapter/verse labels; union retains unmatched labels. Not a guarantee of semantic verse alignment.
comparison.written: OSHB direct verse w elements only for words; retain nested large/small/suspended-letter seg contents and tails. For full-lane punctuation, interleave direct x-maqqef/x-sof-pasuq/x-paseq seg by position. UXLC direct w+k. Never verse.itertext or all descendant w. OSHB morphology separators removed only in normalized lanes.
comparison.qere: OSHB variant-note rdg[type=x-qere] words only; UXLC q only. Preserve empty/multiword/insertion-only alternatives and local positions; compare ordered qere payload through the accent lane (punctuation excluded) separately without claiming global token alignment. Independently flag alternative presence/word-count differences, not apparatus-group equivalence.
comparison.uxlc_mixed_content: Retain word text, s letter-decoration contents and tails; exclude x note text from biblical tokens while recording note codes/attributes separately.
comparison.other_layers: Record OSHB non-qere note type counts and UXLC annotations/decoration metadata, not as words or manuscript votes.
comparison.normalization: Unicode NFD before AND after filtering each lane: removed CGJ, morphology '/' or whitespace can otherwise leave noncanonical mark order. Remove only morphology '/' and CGJ plus whitespace for the normalized full written lane. Consonant lane retains U+05D0..05EA; pointing adds U+05B0..05BC,05BF,05C1,05C2,05C7; accent lane additionally retains U+0591..05AF and05BD. Punctuation/separators remain in full written lane. Canonically equivalent mark-order-only differences are not textual changes in these lanes; raw per-token data retained for difference rows.
comparison.classification: First differing written lane: consonants,pointing,accents,other-format; mutually exclusive. Token boundaries and qere differences flagged separately. No numeric confidence or automatic correction.
comparison.pob_join: Only consonant-difference rows, using mapped canonical filename. Compare source-field consonants to both edition written lanes; preserve neither-match. Source fields may select qere or be critical composites. English is context for later adjudication, not evidence of manuscript wording.
